note: Source audit updated 2026-10-18. These are general rules, not a determination of the person's tax characterization or monthly MAGI. Unknown values are null and flagged. Work-rule income uses MAGI-based household methods under the later federal rule and enacted California law, not a gross-receipts test.
key_principle: No wages-only requirement. Neither the full rent deposit nor the gross Kalshi payout should be treated automatically as countable MAGI. California limits six-month income averaging to seasonal workers; a tax or eligibility expert must determine classification, actual amount and period.

income_types.type: Rental real estate (Schedule E if applicable)
income_types.irs_classification: Rental income after deductible expenses and applicable loss limitations; Schedule E is generally used for rental real estate, subject to IRS exceptions.
income_types.magi_detail: The taxable rental amount can enter MAGI; gross rent receipts and real-estate equity are not interchangeable with taxable income. Actual amount for this person: unknown.
income_types.work_detail: A countable monthly rental amount can contribute to the MAGI-based $580 household income route, but neither the amount nor period has been verified.
income_types.flag: This person's taxable rental result and qualifying monthly amount are unknown.

income_types.irs_classification: Taxable interest is part of adjusted gross income; tax-exempt interest may be added back to MAGI for coverage calculations.
income_types.magi_detail: Count applicable interest, not the savings principal. This person's actual monthly interest is unknown.
income_types.work_detail: Countable monthly interest can contribute to a MAGI-based household income assessment; the actual amount has not been supplied.
